# Aureva Dental Clinic

> Modern boutique dental clinic in Hennur, North Bengaluru, specializing in rotary endodontics, dental implants, clear aligners, aesthetic veneers, laser gum therapy, and pediatric dentistry with hospital-grade sterilization.

Aureva Dental is a premier dental practice located in Hennur Bande / Horamavu Agara Road, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560043. The clinic provides evidence-based dental care with a multi-specialist team led by experienced dental surgeons registered with the Karnataka State Dental Council (KSDC).

## Clinic Operating Hours

- **Tuesday – Sunday**: 9:30 AM – 9:00 PM (Open all day, full emergency coverage)
- **Monday**: 4:00 PM – 9:00 PM (Evening session only)
- **Sunday Emergency Walk-ins**: Fully operational on Sundays for acute dental trauma, severe toothache, and pulpitis triage.

## Core Clinical Specialties

- **Rotary Endodontics**: Single-visit root canal treatments (RCT) utilizing digital apex locators, nickel-titanium rotary files, and rubber dam isolation.
- **Dental Implants**: Single-tooth, multiple-teeth, and full-arch osseointegrated titanium and zirconia implants with digital treatment planning.
- **Clear Aligners**: Removable invisible orthodontics and custom digital alignment trays for mild to complex malocclusions.
- **Pediatric Dentistry**: Child-friendly dental care, fluoride therapy, pit & fissure sealants, space maintainers, and painless restorations.
- **Laser Gum Therapy**: Diode laser-assisted periodontal decontamination, gingivectomy, frenectomy, and aesthetic gum recontouring.
- **Aesthetic Veneers & Smile Makeovers**: Ultra-thin porcelain/ceramic (E-max) veneers, composite bonding, and diastema closure.
- **Wisdom Tooth & Oral Surgery**: Atraumatic surgical extractions of impacted mandibular third molars under local anesthesia.
- **Restorative & Preventative Care**: Tooth-colored composite fillings, zirconia crowns, ultrasonic scaling, and in-office LED teeth whitening.

## Official Payment & Billing Policy

- **Accepted Payment Modes**: All major Credit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay, Amex), Debit Cards, UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), and Net Banking.
- **Installment / EMI Terms**: Aureva Dental does NOT offer direct in-house zero-interest credit loans or no-cost EMI schemes. Patients wishing to split payments into monthly installments can seamlessly convert credit card transactions into flexible monthly EMIs directly via their bank's post-payment portal or net banking app.
- **Transparency Guarantee**: Itemized pre-treatment cost estimates provided prior to any procedure. No hidden chairside surcharges.
